english.title: Carry passenger improperly on a motorcycle - Road Traffic Act 1988
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), drove a motor bicycle, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTORCYCLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), whilst carrying another person who was not sitting astride the motor bicycle on a proper seat securely fixed to it behind the driver's seat.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 23(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
